verdict_note: Nothing found that breaks the build at any commit or fails a named test in a round unit (read only, not compiled). Four cheap fixes in files this lane created (F1 to F4), each worth doing before the one bundled run so it is not repeated. F1 to F3 give wrong refusal codes or change state on a refused row; F4 is a test oracle that can no longer fail. F5 is a push-shape point. If the lead takes F1 to F4 to the next lane, BUILD is defensible: no build break and no test failure was found. Origin cede5958 merges cleanly into the tip (legacy git merge-tree: 0 conflict blocks). The only shared file is harness-core action/commands/document.rs, where origin adds document.submit_layout two lines above the lane's hunk. Origin adds HistoryStep.layout, and the lane builds no HistoryStep literal.

findings.what: leading_code takes the first snake_case token after a lowercase engine prefix. Mixer refusals that never reach the run look like 'mixer: <op> refused: <diagnostic>', so the code becomes the op name (mixer_master_volume, mixer_send, mixer_add_send, mixer_output, mixer_add_effect). That name is also the undo step a successful row returns, so the reply claims a 'reason' that is only the step name. Same class, coarser: the prefix fig_import contains '_' and fails the all-lowercase prefix test, so every design.import_fig engine refusal (decode refused, version unsupported, too large, text over window) answers code 'fig_import'. No test covers this. The one mixer refusal the test checks (volume 99) goes through a different message and correctly gets command_refused.
findings.scenario: mixer.master_volume {"linear": 10}: the non-automated branch sets routing.master.volume unchecked (mixer.rs:491), and folio refuses it as master/volume. The reply is error 'mixer_master_volume'. The same happens for mixer.send {pan: 5}, mixer.add_send with a target track the sequence does not hold, and mixer.add_effect on a bus that is an audio track.
findings.fix: In leading_code, return None when the text after the token starts with ' refused' (the slice is safe: the token ends at an ASCII delimiter). Those refusals then answer command_refused, with the text kept in detail.message. Optionally map the mixer '<op> refused: InvalidField' text to routing_invalid. Add one refused assert, e.g. mixer.master_volume linear 10 -> command_refused (or routing_invalid). Leave fig_import as it is, or name it in DRIVE_LIMITS as one coarse code.

findings.severity: wrong answer / lost state after a refusal
findings.where: crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/commands/mixer.rs:99-106 -> crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/mixer.rs:196-209 (open_mixer stores the new MixerState, then mixer_rebuild returns Err on 'mixer: unknown sequence'); crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/commands/waveform.rs:129-156 -> crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/spectral_display.rs:84-89, :109-133 (open_spectral_display stores the state, then spectral_sync fails)
findings.what: A refused mixer.open or spectral.open still replaces the open engine state. After mixer.open with a sequence id that does not exist, v.mixer is a mixer with no stream bound to that id. If multitrack.open had bound the timeline's mixer, that mixer is gone. Every later mixer.* row refuses 'unknown sequence', and mixer.state shows the broken mixer instead of mixer_closed. After spectral.open with params score refuses (fft_size 3, hop 0, scale log with min_hz 0), the display stays open with those params and the error set. The previous display and its region are lost, and spectral.state reports it open.
findings.scenario: multitrack.open, then mixer.open {"sequence_id": "seq-typo"}: the row refuses command_refused, then mixer.volume on a valid track also refuses. Or spectral.open (good), set_region, then spectral.open {fft_size: 3}: refused, and spectral.apply now answers spectral_no_selection.
findings.fix: In the rows (lane files; the fields are visible to this child module): let old = v.mixer.take(); on Err from open_mixer set v.mixer = old. Do the same with v.spectral around open_spectral_display. Or check that the sequence exists before calling, and refuse unknown_sequence. One refused-then-state assert for each.

findings.severity: wrong answer (valid input refused; partial apply on refusal)
findings.what: monitor.source_mark with both marks applies mark_in, then mark_out, each checked against the other mark already stored. Moving the window to the right is refused: in (3,10), then {mark_in:12, mark_out:20} gets in_after_out although the result (12,20) is valid. When the second call fails, the first one is already applied: in (3,10), then {mark_in:5, mark_out:2} answers out_before_in, but mark_in is now 5.
findings.scenario: The video-edit step that re-marks a later take window in one row.
findings.fix: When both marks are given, refuse in > out first (out_before_in). Then save prev = s.marks(), call clear_marks, then mark_in and mark_out. On any Err, restore prev (clear_marks plus re-mark) and return the refusal.

findings.what: 2bbe2207 gave the program sequence a clip of the same take, because a monitor refuses an empty sequence. The reopen oracle still asserts only that clips is not empty and that every clip's source is the take. The fixture clip satisfies both before any edit, so the assertion 'the edits reached the package' passes even if source_insert and source_overwrite never reach the saved package.
findings.scenario: A regression that drops the source edit steps on save stays green.
findings.fix: Assert that the edits are present: clips.len() > 1 and the sequence duration > 4 * TPF_24 after insert. Better: compare the reopened sequence with the live session's sequence read from a state reply just before document.save.

findings.severity: process (a pushed commit fails its own tests)
findings.where: commit 1ba6389a (lane file tests.focused_1ba6389a: 3 of 6 fail on test expectations); wave-parity-2-common.md common topic, the 'Never push a test with a placeholder expectation ... a pushed commit must pass its own tests' rule
findings.what: 1ba6389a is not a red-first commit, but its own tests fail (undo label form, empty program sequence). The fixes are in 2bbe2207. Pushed as four commits, a round that froze 1ba6389a would fail harness_drive_audio.
findings.scenario: R32 class: a round freezes an intermediate pushed commit.
findings.fix: Before the push, squash 2bbe2207 into 1ba6389a (local only, not pushed yet); the red commit a1a68f93 stays separate.

findings.what: monitor.bind_program_media with an empty files list answers media_too_many {files: 0}. The engine itself accepts an empty list.
findings.scenario: files: [] or files: "" (comma text that splits to nothing).
findings.fix: Refuse the empty list as parameter_invalid {key: files, expected: '1..=64 files'}. Keep media_too_many for more than 64.

findings.severity: minor silent drops (declared parameter accepted and ignored)
findings.what: These declared parameters are accepted and then dropped with no refusal and no note in the reply: monitor.key frames on keys other than step_back/step_forward; spectral.open min_hz with scale linear; spectral.apply gain_db with ops other than attenuate; waveform.select channels with no start/end (it clears the selection); prototype.capture_frame overwrite with no path.
findings.scenario: A model passes spectral.open {scale: linear, min_hz: 50} and believes the floor frequency was applied.
findings.fix: Refuse with parameter_conflict naming the key, or state the rule in the row docs and DRIVE_LIMITS. Non-blocking.
